subject: CDBG Annual Performance and Evaluation Report
overview: City staff presented the Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report (CAPER) detailing Medford's Community Development Block Grant accomplishments and solicited public input on future funding priorities.

items.title: Call to Order and Introduction
items.summary: Director of Planning, Development and Sustainability Alicia Hunt opened the public hearing on the Community Development Block Grant annual performance report.

items.title: Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report Presentation
items.summary: CDBG Manager Laurel Siegel reviewed the past year's grant-funded infrastructure, housing, public service, and economic development accomplishments, outlined upcoming projects, and invited public feedback on community funding priorities.
